```{python}
import html as _html
import json
from pathlib import Path
from IPython.display import HTML, display

_candidates = [Path("quarto-data/portfolio-explorer.json"), Path("../quarto-data/portfolio-explorer.json")]
data_file = next((p for p in _candidates if p.exists()), None)
if data_file is None:
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        "quarto-data/portfolio-explorer.json not found. "
        "Run: python NceGitLab.py --report portfolio-explorer"
    )

d      = json.loads(data_file.read_text())
group  = d["group"]
totals = d["totals"]
epics  = d["portfolio_epics"]

# Presentation copies of EPIC_TYPE_ICONS (NceGitLab.py) and the metric
# definitions in mixins/reports.py (_PFX_DEFINITIONS_MD) — keep in sync.
ICONS = {"Epic": "⚡", "Capability": "💠", "Feature": "🔖", "Issue": "📋"}

def esc(s):
    return _html.escape(str(s if s is not None else "?"))

def link(title, url):
    return f'<a href="{esc(url)}" target="_blank">{esc(title)}</a>'
```

```{python}
HTML(f"""
<p>
  <strong>Report Date:</strong> {d['report_date']} &nbsp;|&nbsp;
  <strong>Group:</strong> {link(group['name'], group['url'])}
</p>
<p><em>Every portfolio epic, attention first — blocking chains and value at risk,
as shown in the app's Portfolio Explorer.</em></p>
""")
```

## Summary

```{python}
def tier_table(sums, caption=None):
    html = '<table class="table table-sm table-bordered" style="max-width:520px">'
    if caption:
        html += f"<caption>{caption}</caption>"
    html += "<thead><tr><th></th><th>Direct</th><th>Downstream</th><th>Subtree</th></tr></thead><tbody>"
    html += (f"<tr><td>★ Business Value</td><td>{sums['blocked_business_value']}</td>"
             f"<td><strong>{sums['blocked_business_value_downstream']}</strong></td>"
             f"<td>{sums['blocked_business_value_subtree']}</td></tr>")
    html += (f"<tr><td>⚓ Weight</td><td>{sums['blocked_weight']}</td>"
             f"<td><strong>{sums['blocked_weight_downstream']}</strong></td>"
             f"<td>{sums['blocked_weight_subtree']}</td></tr>")
    return html + "</tbody></table>"

html = '<table class="table table-sm table-striped" style="max-width:480px"><thead><tr><th>Metric</th><th>Count</th></tr></thead><tbody>'
html += f"<tr><td>Portfolio Epics</td><td><strong>{totals['portfolio_epics']}</strong></td></tr>"
html += f"<tr><td>Need attention</td><td><strong>{totals['needs_attention']}</strong></td></tr>"
html += f"<tr><td>Blocked items (deduped)</td><td><strong>{totals['blocked_items']}</strong></td></tr>"
if totals.get("untyped_in_chains"):
    html += (f"<tr><td>❓ Untyped epics in chains</td>"
             f"<td><strong>{totals['untyped_in_chains']}</strong></td></tr>")
html += "</tbody></table>"
html += tier_table(totals, caption="Value &amp; weight at risk — deduped across portfolio epics")
HTML(html)
```

## Metric definitions

| Metric | Counts | Reads as |
|--------|--------|----------|
| **Direct** | the blocked items themselves — BV on those items; weight is each blocked branch's **effective weight** (its own set weight, else the sum of its children's, down to the issue roll-up) | "the work items that can't move" |
| **Downstream** | blocked items **plus their open descendants** | "value that can't be delivered until this clears" — closed value is already delivered, so it never counts as at risk (open work behind a closed item still does) |
| **Subtree** | blocked items plus **all** descendants, closed included — for weight this equals Direct, since a branch's effective weight already covers its subtree | "how big the threatened branch is" — sizing and exposure, not risk |

## Portfolio Epics (attention first)

```{python}
def chain_node(n):
    icon = ICONS.get(n.get("type"), "❓")
    text = f'{icon} {link(n.get("title"), n.get("web_url", ""))}'
    if n.get("type") is None:
        text += " <em>(untyped)</em>"
    if not n.get("blocked"):
        return text
    if n.get("state") == "closed":
        return (f'⛔ <s>{text}</s> <em>(blocked · closed — consider clearing '
                f'the blocking links)</em>')
    return f"⛔ <strong>{text}</strong>"

def blocker_ref(b):
    item_type = b.get("item_type") or "Epic"
    icon = ICONS["Issue"] if item_type == "Issue" else ICONS.get(b.get("type"), "❓")
    return f'{icon} {link(b.get("title"), b.get("web_url", ""))}'

if not epics:
    display(HTML("<p>No portfolio epics (<code>epic::epic</code> tier) found in the snapshot.</p>"))

out = []
for entry in epics:
    epic, flags, rollup = entry["epic"], entry["flags"], entry["rollup"]
    state    = {"opened": "Open", "closed": "Closed"}.get(epic.get("state"), "—")
    done     = epic.get("pct_complete")
    through  = epic.get("pct_through_pi")
    progress = f"{done or 0}% done"
    if through is not None:
        progress += f" / {through}% through PI"

    badges = []
    if flags["blocked"]:
        badges.append(f'<span style="color:#c0392b">⛔ blocked ({rollup["blocked_count"]})</span>')
    if flags["behind_schedule"]:
        badges.append('<span style="color:#c0392b">⏱ behind schedule</span>')
    if not badges:
        badges.append('<span style="color:#27ae60">✅ on track</span>')

    body = (f"<p><strong>State:</strong> {state} &nbsp;·&nbsp; "
            f"<strong>PI:</strong> {esc(epic.get('piid') or '—')} &nbsp;·&nbsp; "
            f"<strong>Progress:</strong> {progress}</p>")

    if flags["blocked"]:
        body += tier_table(rollup)
        body += "<p><strong>Blocking chains</strong></p><ul>"
        for chain in entry["chains"]:
            line = " → ".join(chain_node(n) for n in chain["nodes"])
            blockers = chain.get("blockers") or []
            if blockers:
                line += " — blocked by " + ", ".join(blocker_ref(b) for b in blockers)
            body += f"<li>{line}</li>"
        body += "</ul>"

    out.append(
        f'<details {"open" if entry["needs_attention"] else ""}>'
        f'<summary>⚡ {link(epic["title"], epic.get("web_url", ""))} '
        f'&nbsp; {" &nbsp; ".join(badges)}</summary>{body}</details>'
    )

HTML("\n".join(out))
```
